import re

def solve(env, goal):
    # Extract object name from goal ("put a cool <obj> in <target>")
    m = re.search(r'cool (\w+)', goal)
    if m:
        obj = m.group(1)
    else:
        m = re.search(r'put a (\w+) in', goal)
        obj = m.group(1)
    
    # Extract target receptacle
    m = re.search(r'in (\w+)', goal)
    target = m.group(1)
    
    # Look to get the room description
    env.step("look")
    room = env.observation
    
    # Regex to match "a <object> [number]" in observations
    obj_re = re.compile(r'\ba\s+' + re.escape(obj) + r'(?:\s+\d+)?', re.IGNORECASE)
    
    # Search in the room description first
    if obj_re.search(room):
        env.step(f"take {obj} 1")
    else:
        # Extract unique receptacle names from the room description
        receptacles = re.findall(r'\b([a-z]+)\s+\d+', room)
        seen = set()
        for Recepacle in receptacles:
            if Recepacle in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(Recepacle)
            
            env.step(f"go to {Recepacle} 1")
            obs = env.observation
            
            # Check items on the receptacle surface
            items_match = re.search(r'On the [^,]+, you see ([^.]+)', obs)
            if items_match:
                if obj_re.search(items_match.group(1)):
                    env.step(f"take {obj} 1")
                    break
            
            # Check items inside (e.g., in cabinets, drawers)
            in_match = re.search(r'In it, you see ([^.]+)', obs)
            if in_match:
                if obj_re.search(in_match.group(1)):
                    env.step(f"take {obj} 1")
                    break
    
    # Cool the object with the fridge
    env.step("go to fridge 1")
    env.step("open fridge 1")
    env.step(f"cool {obj} 1 with fridge 1")
    env.step("close fridge 1")
    
    # Move to the target receptacle and place the object there
    env.step(f"go to {target} 1")
    env.step(f"move {obj} 1 to {target} 1")
